𝗜 𝗨𝘀𝗲𝗱 𝗠𝘆 𝗡𝘂𝗺𝗺𝘂𝘀 𝗩𝗶𝗿𝘁𝘂𝗮𝗹 𝗖𝗮𝗿𝗱 𝘁𝗼 𝗦𝗵𝗼𝗽 𝗼𝗻 𝗧𝗲𝗺𝘂

If you have been wondering how to pay for your Temu orders or you have been having issues with your usual payment method, the @NummusWallet virtual card might be worth trying. 

I recently used my Nummus virtual Visa card to shop on Temu, and the process was pretty straightforward. You can add the card to Temu at checkout and use it to pay for the items in your cart.

𝗦𝘁𝗲𝗽 𝟭: 𝗧𝗿𝗮𝗻𝘀𝗳𝗲𝗿 𝗠𝗼𝗻𝗲𝘆 𝘁𝗼 𝗬𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗩𝗶𝗿𝘁𝘂𝗮𝗹 𝗖𝗮𝗿𝗱

First, you need to move the crypto balance you already have in your Nummus Wallet to your virtual card. From the Nummus homepage, click Transfer, then select My Account, and choose Virtual Account. 

Enter the amount you want to move to your virtual card and confirm the transfer. Once completed, the money is deposited into the card.

𝗦𝘁𝗲𝗽 𝟮: 𝗔𝗱𝗱 𝗬𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗡𝘂𝗺𝗺𝘂𝘀 𝗖𝗮𝗿𝗱 𝘁𝗼 𝗧𝗲𝗺𝘂

Once your balance is on the virtual card, head over to the Temu app and add it as your payment method. 

Add the items you want to buy to your cart, proceed to Checkout, and select the option to add a card. 

Enter your Nummus virtual Visa card details, save the card, and you can use it to pay for your order.

The best part is that the Nummus virtual Visa card is 𝗙𝗥𝗘𝗘, so you do not need to wait for a physical card before making online payments. 

You can use it anywhere Visa is accepted, which makes it handy for shopping online and handling everyday payments.

If you want to try it yourself, download Nummus Wallet from the App Store or Google Play and get started.

top_posts.translation_zh:
我用我的 Nummus 虚拟卡在 Temu 上购物

如果你一直在想该如何支付 Temu 订单，或者你常用的付款方式一直有问题，@NummusWallet 虚拟卡可能值得一试。

我最近用我的 Nummus 虚拟 Visa 卡在 Temu 上购物，整个过程相当简单。你可以在结账时把这张卡添加到 Temu，并用它支付购物车里的商品。

步骤 1：向你的虚拟卡转账

首先，你需要把 Nummus Wallet 里已有的加密货币余额转到你的虚拟卡。从 Nummus 首页点击 Transfer，然后选择 My Account，再选择 Virtual Account。

输入你想转到虚拟卡的金额并确认转账。完成后，钱就会存入卡中。

步骤 2：把你的 Nummus 卡添加到 Temu

余额到达虚拟卡后，打开 Temu app，把它添加为你的付款方式。

把你想买的商品加入购物车，进入 Checkout，并选择添加卡片的选项。

输入你的 Nummus 虚拟 Visa 卡信息，保存卡片，然后你就可以用它来支付订单。

最棒的是，Nummus 虚拟 Visa 卡是免费的，所以你不需要等实体卡才能进行线上支付。

只要是接受 Visa 的地方都可以使用，这让它非常适合网购和处理日常付款。

如果你想自己试试，可以从 App Store 或 Google Play 下载 Nummus Wallet 并开始使用。
